{{Quote|Sir, if we requisition the ordnance from Project X271 in the Outer Rim Territories, we could incinerate the bacterium from orbit&hellip;''"<br />"''And annihilate every living thing on the planet. No. The Emperor may still have some use for the Falleen.|Captain Bolvan and Darth Vader|<ref name="TLE">{{WEGCite|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook|story=The Lesser Evil}}</ref>}}
'''Project X271''' was undertaken by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to produce a weapon capable of destroying every living thing on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="TLE" /> In [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] visited the research facilities in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during an exploration tour of similar weapon development projects.<ref name="ff">{{FactFile|69|XIZ 1-4|Prince Xizor}}</ref> When he arrived at the planet [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]] aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bolvan/Legends|Bolvan]] suggested using ordnance from Project X271 to incinerate a quickly spreading [[Flesh-eating bacterium|bacterial plague]], which broke loose from an Imperial [[bacteriological research outpost]]. Vader disagreed and ordered [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Hija/Legends|Hija]] to conduct [[Bombardment of Falleen|turbolaser bombardment]] instead, thereby destroying the laboratories and everything within forty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]]. The bacterium, along with 200,000 native [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] were annihilated.<ref name="TLE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Project X271 was first mentioned in "[[The Lesser Evil]]," a short narrative published in the [[1996]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook ''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]].<ref name="TLE" />
